_comment: Reviewed test deletions (#11601). scripts/ci/check_deleted_test_files.py exempts a deleted tests/**/*.py file only when it is listed here with a governing issue ('#N' or an issue/PR URL) and a non-empty reason. Add the entry in the same PR that deletes the test so the approval is reviewed with the deletion. A malformed file fails the guard closed.
